sources.title: Introducing Inkling-Small (July 30, 2026)
sources.evidence: Dated announcement explicitly releases the full weights and Tinker access; specifies nominal 276B total and 12B active parameters, MoE Transformer, variable thinking effort, native image/audio input, and tool-use workflows.

sources.title: Inkling-Small Model Card
sources.evidence: Names provider Thinking Machines Lab, Inc.; gives July 30, 2026 release and Apache 2.0 license; describes 42-layer sparse MoE, 6 of 256 routed experts plus 2 shared, nominal 276B/12B, text/image/audio input and text output.

sources.title: Inkling-Small pinned checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Revision 8cc5877b44d343f88b92086aa1fb72897950f06a: InklingForConditionalGeneration, model_max_length 1048576, 42 decoder layers, hidden size 4096, 256 routed experts/top-6 and 2 shared experts; separate vision/audio configurations and eight MTP layers.

sources.title: Inkling-Small pinned chat template
sources.evidence: Supports numerical or named reasoning effort, explicit thinking messages, tool schema declarations, assistant-selected named function calls with structured arguments, and corresponding tool results. Text/image/audio message serialization is present.

sources.title: Inkling-Small pinned Hugging Face model card
sources.evidence: Apache-2.0 metadata with license link; confirms open-weight multimodal autoregressive MoE model, nominal 276B/12B, and advertised text/image/audio input with text output.

sources.title: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model (July 15, 2026)
sources.evidence: The Inkling-Small section previews an earlier checkpoint and expressly says testing is still being completed and its full weights will be released afterward. The July 30 post describes additional RL training from that preview.

sources.title: Inkling model family
sources.evidence: Places Inkling and Inkling-Small in the Inkling family; lists Small nominal 276B total/12B active and 1M model context, while distinguishing 64K/256K Tinker limits.

sources.title: Inkling-Small repository metadata
sources.evidence: Resolves the pinned revision and downloadable BF16 shards plus mtp.safetensors. Automated safetensors metadata reports about 266B storage elements, differing from the developer nominal276B; no exact learned parameter total is derived from this badge.

sources.title: Inkling-Small pinned shard index
sources.evidence: Maps the checkpoint to 32 main shards plus mtp.safetensors, for 33 indexed files. The exact learned-module total, including ties and buffers, has not been independently reconciled in this audit.

name.note: Use the exact developer model name, including its hyphen.

developer.note: The model card names the legal provider Thinking Machines Lab, Inc.; use its public brand.

family.note: The developer groups both sizes under Inkling. Baseline ling is an erroneous substring.

release_date.note: Explicit model-card release date and same-day availability announcement. July 15 disclosed preview results with weights still forthcoming; July 27 repository creation is not the release.

open_weights.note: Developer releases full downloadable weights with BF16 and quantized distributions.

license.note: Exact model card states Apache 2.0; pinned HF metadata links that license. The separately linked acceptable-use policy is not represented as a different model license.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total, not an exact tensor-derived count. The approximately 266B HF automated storage total differs from this nominal figure; its cause is not resolved here. The index includes all 32 main shards plus MTP. No exact learned-module total is claimed.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal active count for this exact model. It is not independently derived from total parameters or an assumed routing formula; no finer component convention is asserted.

architecture.note: 42-layer autoregressive decoder with sparse MoE feed-forward blocks; 6 routed experts selected from 256 plus 2 shared. Config corroborates local/global attention and native multimodal adapters.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint model_max_length is 1,048,576, matching the advertised 1M model context. Hosted Tinker limits of 64K/256K are separate.

modalities.note: Advertised native input/output modalities, corroborated by configuration and template. Video in training data or temporal patch metadata does not establish an advertised video-input capability.

reasoning.note: Developer advertises adjustable reasoning; exact checkpoint template emits effort conditioning and separate reasoning content, including a none/zero effort setting.

tool_call.note: Model card and announcement describe tool-use systems; exact template implements tool declarations, model-selected function name/arguments, and tool-return messages.

description.value: Open-weight multimodal MoE model with adjustable reasoning effort, tool calling, and text output from text, image, or audio input.
description.note: Concise supported capabilities; removes unqualified parameter figures from prose because their nominal precision is recorded separately.

patch.name: Inkling-Small
patch.description: Open-weight multimodal MoE model with adjustable reasoning effort, tool calling, and text output from text, image, or audio input.
patch.notes: 276B total and 12B active are developer-reported nominal figures. The HF automated storage total is approximately 266B; this audit does not reconcile the difference or claim an exact learned parameter count. The 1,048,576-token limit is the checkpoint context; hosted Tinker limits differ. July 15 preview results preceded the July 30 full release.

summary: Filled missing nominal total/active parameter counts and MoE architecture from exact primary documentation; corrected the family to inkling and normalized the model/provider names. Confirmed July 30 release, Apache-2.0 weights, 1,048,576 model context, native text/image/audio input, reasoning and function calling. No exact checkpoint count or current endpoint operation is claimed.
